en.R: This is the family of Aaron and Moses at the time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.

fr.B: Voici la descendance d’Aaron et de Moïse, au temps où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parla avec Moïse sur le mont Sinaï.

sw.B: Hii ndiyo orodha ya ukoo wa Haruni na Musa wakati {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipozungumza na Musa juu ya mlima Sinai.

vi.R: Đây là gia đình của A-rôn và Môi-se vào thời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Môi-se trên núi Si-na-i.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시내 산에서 모세와 말씀하신 날에, 아론과 모세의 계보는 이러하였다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시내 산에서 모세와 말씀하실 때에 아론과 모세의 집안은 이러하였다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시내 산에서 모세와 말씀하실 때, 아론과 모세의 가족은 이러했다.

pt.L: E estas [são] as gerações de Arão e de Moisés no dia em que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou com Moisés no monte Sinai.
pt.B: Esta é a linhagem de Arão e de Moisés no tempo em que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou com Moisés no monte Sinai.
pt.R: Esta é a família de Arão e de Moisés no tempo em que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou com Moisés no monte Sinai.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሲና ተራራ ከሙሴ ጋር በተናገረበት ቀን የአሮንና የሙሴ ትውልድ ታሪክ ይህ ነው።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሲና ተራራ ከሙሴ ጋር በተነጋገረበት ጊዜ የአሮንና የሙሴ ትውልድ ታሪክ ይህ ነው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሲና ተራራ ከሙሴ ጋር በተነጋገረበት ጊዜ የነበረው የአሮንና የሙሴ ቤተሰብ ይህ ነው።

decisions.choice: generations: the family line that comes from someone
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "to give birth" and heads family records through Genesis (Genesis 2:4; 5:1; 11:27). Here only Aaron's sons follow (verses 2-4). Moses is named because he and Aaron head the tribe of Levi together, but his own sons are counted among the ordinary Levites (1 Chronicles 23:13-14), so the record goes on with the priestly line.

decisions.choice: on the day: at the time when
decisions.reason: "On the day" often means "when" or "at the time" rather than one day of twenty-four hours (Genesis 2:4). It places these men at the time of the laws given at Sinai.

decisions.choice: family line / family
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the list is; "generations" in this sense is no longer common English. Literal keeps the old term so the reader can link it to the other family records.

decisions.choice: passé simple for the narrative at Literal and Balanced ("parla"); passé composé at Readable ("a parlé"); the LORD's instructions in the future at Literal and Balanced, "tu dois" or the imperative at Readable
decisions.reason: As the French style guide and Numbers 1 set: the passé simple is the tense of written French narrative and the passé composé the tense of spoken French and of school reading, which suits Readable. When God speaks of what he did in the past (verse 13) French uses the passé composé at every level, as speech does.

decisions.choice: "la descendance"
decisions.reason: The word heads a family record (m1), and only Aaron's sons follow, so Balanced says "la descendance"; Literal keeps "les générations" to link the verse with the other family records, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "계보" for "generations" at Literal; "집안" (Balanced) and "가족" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Genesis term sheet uses "계보" for this heading at Literal; here only a family list follows, so the other levels name the family itself, as the English "family line" does.

decisions.choice: "dòng dõi" (L), "dòng họ" (B), "gia đình" (R) for "generations" (toledot)
alternatives: "câu chuyện về dòng họ" as in Genesis at Balanced
decisions.reason: Here the word introduces a short family list, not a story, so Balanced says "dòng họ" (family line) and Readable "gia đình"; Literal keeps the Genesis sheet's "dòng dõi".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter.
alternatives: marking pronouns for God with a setting
decisions.reason: The English capitalises pronouns for God under a setting (3:12-13, 3:41, 3:45); the Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "የ… ትውልድ ታሪክ ይህ ነው" (L, B) and "የ… ቤተሰብ ይህ ነው" (R) for "these are the generations of".
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch terms list sets "ትውልድ ታሪክ" for toledot. What follows here is a family list, so Readable speaks of the family, as the English does.

en.L: And these [are] the names of the sons of Aaron: the firstborn Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
en.B: These are the names of Aaron's sons: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
en.R: Aaron's sons were Nadab, who was the oldest, and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

es.B: Estos son los nombres de los hijos de Aarón: Nadab, el primogénito, y Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
es.R: Los hijos de Aarón eran Nadab, que era el mayor, y Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.

fr.L: Et voici les noms des fils d’Aaron : le premier-né Nadab, et Abihou, Éléazar et Ithamar.
fr.B: Voici les noms des fils d’Aaron : Nadab, le premier-né, puis Abihou, Éléazar et Ithamar.
fr.R: Les fils d’Aaron étaient Nadab, l’aîné, puis Abihou, Éléazar et Ithamar.

sw.L: Na haya [ndiyo] majina ya wana wa Haruni: mzaliwa wa kwanza Nadabu, na Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
sw.B: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Haruni: Nadabu mzaliwa wa kwanza, na Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
sw.R: Wana wa Haruni walikuwa Nadabu, aliyekuwa mkubwa wao, na Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.

vi.B: Đây là tên các con trai A-rôn: Na-đáp là con đầu lòng, rồi A-bi-hu, Ê-lê-a-sa và Y-tha-ma.
vi.R: A-rôn có các con trai là Na-đáp, con trai cả, rồi A-bi-hu, Ê-lê-a-sa và Y-tha-ma.

ko.L: 그리고 아론의 아들들의 이름은 이러하니, 맏아들 나답과 아비후와 엘르아살과 이다말이다.
ko.B: 아론의 아들들의 이름은 맏아들 나답, 그리고 아비후, 엘르아살, 이다말이다.

pt.L: E estes [são] os nomes dos filhos de Arão: o primogênito Nadabe, e Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
pt.B: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Arão: Nadabe, o primogênito, e Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
pt.R: Os filhos de Arão foram Nadabe, que era o mais velho, e Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.

am.L: የአሮንም ልጆች ስሞች እነዚህ [ናቸው]፤ በኩሩ ናዳብ፣ አብዩድም፣ አልዓዛርና ኢታምር።

decisions.choice: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar: the four sons of Aaron
decisions.reason: The same four are named in Exodus 6:23 and 28:1, where they are chosen with their father to serve as priests.

source.text: אֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַמְּשֻׁחִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר־מִלֵּ֥א יָדָ֖ם לְכַהֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: These [are the] names of [the] sons of Aaron, the priests, the anointed, whom he filled their hand to serve as priest.

en.L: These [are] the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whose hand he filled to serve as priests.
en.B: These were the names of Aaron's sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.
en.R: They were the priests. They had been anointed with oil and set apart to serve as priests.

es.L: Estos [son] los nombres de los hijos de Aarón, los sacerdotes ungidos, a quienes él llenó la mano para ejercer el sacerdocio.
es.B: Estos eran los nombres de los hijos de Aarón, los sacerdotes ungidos, que fueron investidos para servir como sacerdotes.
es.R: Ellos eran los sacerdotes. Habían sido ungidos con aceite y apartados para servir como sacerdotes.

fr.L: Voici les noms des fils d’Aaron, les prêtres oints, dont il remplit la main pour exercer le sacerdoce.
fr.B: Tels étaient les noms des fils d’Aaron, les prêtres oints, qui furent investis pour exercer le sacerdoce.
fr.R: Ils étaient prêtres. On les avait oints d’huile et mis à part pour servir comme prêtres.

sw.B: Haya ndiyo yaliyokuwa majina ya wana wa Haruni, makuhani waliopakwa mafuta, waliosimikwa ili watumike kama makuhani.
sw.R: Hao ndio waliokuwa makuhani. Walikuwa wamepakwa mafuta na kutengwa ili watumike kama makuhani.

vi.L: Đây [là] tên các con trai A-rôn, các thầy tế lễ được xức dầu, mà ông đã làm đầy tay họ để làm thầy tế lễ.
vi.B: Đó là tên các con trai A-rôn, những thầy tế lễ đã được xức dầu và được lập lên để làm thầy tế lễ.
vi.R: Họ là các thầy tế lễ. Họ đã được xức dầu và được biệt riêng ra để làm thầy tế lễ.

ko.L: 이들은 아론의 아들들, 곧 기름 부음 받은 제사장들의 이름이니, 그가 그들의 손을 채워 제사장 직분을 행하게 하였다.
ko.B: 이들이 아론의 아들들, 곧 기름 부음 받은 제사장들의 이름이다. 그들은 제사장 직분을 맡도록 위임받았다.
ko.R: 그들은 제사장이었다. 그들은 기름 부음을 받고 제사장으로 일하도록 구별되었다.

pt.L: Estes [são] os nomes dos filhos de Arão, os sacerdotes ungidos, cuja mão ele encheu para servirem como sacerdotes.
pt.B: Esses eram os nomes dos filhos de Arão, os sacerdotes ungidos, que foram investidos no cargo para servir como sacerdotes.
pt.R: Eles eram os sacerdotes. Tinham sido ungidos com óleo e separados para servir como sacerdotes.

am.L: ካህናት ሆነው እንዲያገለግሉ እጃቸውን የሞላው፣ የተቀቡት ካህናት፣ የአሮን ልጆች ስሞች እነዚህ [ናቸው]።
am.B: እነዚህ ካህናት ሆነው እንዲያገለግሉ የተሾሙት፣ የተቀቡት ካህናት፣ የአሮን ልጆች ስሞች ነበሩ።
am.R: እነርሱ ካህናት ነበሩ። በዘይት ተቀብተው ካህናት ሆነው እንዲያገለግሉ ተሾሙ።

decisions.choice: filled their hand: ordained, installed in the office
decisions.reason: "To fill the hand" is the Hebrew way of saying that someone is installed as priest (Exodus 28:41; 29:9; Judges 17:5). The picture may come from placing the parts of the ordination offering in the priests' hands (Leviticus 8:27).

decisions.choice: he filled: Moses, acting at God's command
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. In Leviticus 8 it is Moses who carries out the ordination, as the LORD commanded him (Exodus 29:1-9; Leviticus 8:33).

decisions.choice: the anointed priests: priests set apart by anointing with oil
decisions.reason: Oil was poured or sprinkled on Aaron and his sons to set them apart as holy for God's service (Exodus 30:30; Leviticus 8:12, 30).

decisions.choice: who were ordained
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the passive because the Hebrew does not name who ordained them (m2) and "filled their hand" would not be understood (m1). Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: "làm đầy tay" (L), "được lập lên" (B) for "filled their hand"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, as the Vietnamese of Exodus 28-29 does; Balanced says what it means, installed in the office, with a plain word rather than the church term "phong chức".

decisions.choice: "그들의 손을 채워" (Literal) and "위임받았다" (Balanced) for "filled their hand"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, as Exodus 29:33 does in Korean; Balanced uses the word for being installed in an office, which is what the meaning decision says the idiom means.

decisions.choice: cuja mão ele encheu (L); foram investidos no cargo (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom "encher a mão" for installing a priest (m1), as Exodus 28:41 and Leviticus 8:33 do in Portuguese; Balanced says "investidos no cargo", the wording of Leviticus 16:32 and of "a investidura" (Leviticus 8), since "ordenados" would also be read as "commanded".

decisions.choice: "እጃቸውን የሞላው" (L) and "የተሾሙት", "ተሾሙ" (B, R) for "whose hand he filled".
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 28-29 and Leviticus 8: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom, the other levels say what it means, installed in office.

source.text: וַיָּ֣מָת נָדָ֣ב וַאֲבִיה֣וּא לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֡ה בְּֽהַקְרִבָם֩ אֵ֨שׁ זָרָ֜ה לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַיְכַהֵ֤ן אֶלְעָזָר֙ וְאִ֣יתָמָ֔ר עַל־פְּנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֲבִיהֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And died Nadab and Abihu before Yahweh when they brought near strange fire before Yahweh in [the] wilderness of Sinai, and sons not were to them; and served as priest Eleazar and Ithamar on [the] face of Aaron their father.

en.L: And Nadab and Abihu died before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} when they brought near strange fire before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no sons; and Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests before the face of Aaron their father.
en.B: But Nadab and Abihu died in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} when they offered an improper fire before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the wilderness of Sinai. They had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests in the lifetime of their father Aaron.
en.R: But Nadab and Abihu died in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. That happened in the Sinai desert, when they offered {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the wrong kind of fire. They had no sons. So Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests while their father Aaron was still alive.

es.L: Y murieron Nadab y Abiú delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} cuando ofrecieron fuego extraño delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en el desierto del Sinaí, y no tenían hijos; y ejercieron el sacerdocio Eleazar e Itamar delante del rostro de Aarón, su padre.
es.B: Pero Nadab y Abiú murieron en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} cuando ofrecieron un fuego no autorizado delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en el desierto del Sinaí. No tenían hijos, así que Eleazar e Itamar sirvieron como sacerdotes en vida de su padre Aarón.
es.R: Pero Nadab y Abiú murieron delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Eso pasó en el desierto del Sinaí, cuando le ofrecieron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un fuego que no era el correcto. No tenían hijos. Por eso Eleazar e Itamar sirvieron como sacerdotes mientras su padre Aarón todavía vivía.

fr.L: Et Nadab et Abihou moururent devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} quand ils présentèrent un feu étranger devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans le désert du Sinaï, et ils n’avaient pas de fils ; et Éléazar et Ithamar exercèrent le sacerdoce devant la face d’Aaron, leur père.
fr.B: Mais Nadab et Abihou moururent en présence {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} lorsqu’ils offrirent un feu non autorisé devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dans le désert du Sinaï. Ils n’avaient pas de fils ; aussi Éléazar et Ithamar exercèrent-ils le sacerdoce du vivant de leur père Aaron.
fr.R: Mais Nadab et Abihou sont morts devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Cela s’est passé dans le désert du Sinaï, quand ils ont offert {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un feu qui n’était pas le bon. Ils n’avaient pas de fils. Alors Éléazar et Ithamar ont servi comme prêtres pendant que leur père Aaron était encore en vie.

sw.L: Na Nadabu na Abihu wakafa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} walipoleta moto wa kigeni mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika nyika ya Sinai, wala hawakuwa na wana; na Eleazari na Ithamari wakatumika kama makuhani mbele ya uso wa Haruni baba yao.
sw.B: Lakini Nadabu na Abihu walikufa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} walipotoa moto usioruhusiwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika nyika ya Sinai. Hawakuwa na wana, kwa hiyo Eleazari na Ithamari walitumika kama makuhani wakati wa uhai wa baba yao Haruni.
sw.R: Lakini Nadabu na Abihu walikufa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hilo lilitokea katika jangwa la Sinai, walipomtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} moto ambao haukuwa moto unaofaa. Hawakuwa na wana. Kwa hiyo Eleazari na Ithamari walitumika kama makuhani wakati baba yao Haruni alipokuwa bado hai.

vi.L: Và Na-đáp và A-bi-hu chết trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} khi họ dâng lửa lạ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong hoang mạc Si-na-i, và họ không có con trai; và Ê-lê-a-sa và Y-tha-ma làm thầy tế lễ trước mặt A-rôn cha họ.
vi.B: Nhưng Na-đáp và A-bi-hu đã chết trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} khi dâng lửa không đúng phép trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong hoang mạc Si-na-i. Họ không có con trai, nên Ê-lê-a-sa và Y-tha-ma làm thầy tế lễ khi A-rôn cha họ còn sống.
vi.R: Nhưng Na-đáp và A-bi-hu đã chết trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Việc ấy xảy ra trong hoang mạc Si-na-i, khi họ dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một thứ lửa không đúng. Họ không có con trai. Vì vậy Ê-lê-a-sa và Y-tha-ma làm thầy tế lễ trong khi A-rôn cha họ vẫn còn sống.

ko.L: 그리고 나답과 아비후는 시내 광야에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 낯선 불을 가까이 드렸을 때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 죽었고, 그들에게는 아들들이 없었다. 그리고 엘르아살과 이다말이 그들의 아버지 아론의 얼굴 앞에서 제사장 직분을 행하였다.
ko.B: 그러나 나답과 아비후는 시내 광야에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 합당하지 않은 불을 드렸다가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 죽었다. 그들에게는 아들이 없었으므로, 엘르아살과 이다말이 그들의 아버지 아론이 살아 있는 동안 제사장 일을 하였다.
ko.R: 그러나 나답과 아비후는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 죽었다. 그 일은 시내 광야에서 일어났는데, 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 잘못된 불을 드렸을 때였다. 그들에게는 아들이 없었다. 그래서 엘르아살과 이다말이 그들의 아버지 아론이 아직 살아 있을 때 제사장으로 일했다.

pt.L: E Nadabe e Abiú morreram diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} quando ofereceram fogo estranho diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} no deserto do Sinai, e eles não tinham filhos; e Eleazar e Itamar serviram como sacerdotes diante da face de Arão, o pai deles.
pt.B: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram na presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} quando ofereceram um fogo não autorizado diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} no deserto do Sinai. Eles não tinham filhos, e assim Eleazar e Itamar serviram como sacerdotes durante a vida do seu pai Arão.
pt.R: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Isso aconteceu no deserto do Sinai, quando eles ofereceram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} um fogo que não era o certo. Eles não tinham filhos. Por isso Eleazar e Itamar serviram como sacerdotes enquanto o pai deles, Arão, ainda estava vivo.

decisions.choice: strange fire: the fire of Leviticus 10:1-2
decisions.reason: The verse recalls how Nadab and Abihu offered fire that the LORD had not commanded and were consumed by fire from before him (Leviticus 10:1-2; Numbers 26:61). "Strange" means not authorized, outside what God had laid down; the exact fault is not explained.

decisions.choice: they had no sons: no priestly line came from them
decisions.reason: The priesthood passed from father to son. Because the two died without sons, the priesthood continued only through Eleazar and Ithamar (1 Chronicles 24:1-2).

decisions.choice: on the face of Aaron their father: in Aaron's presence, during his lifetime
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean "in the sight of" or "during the life of" (Genesis 11:28). Eleazar and Ithamar served while Aaron was still alive and high priest, under his eye.

decisions.choice: That happened in the Sinai desert ...
decisions.reason: Readable divides the long sentence and states the place and the cause in separate sentences.

decisions.choice: "낯선 불" (Literal), "합당하지 않은 불" (Balanced), "잘못된 불" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The same words Korean Leviticus 10:1 uses for this fire at each level, so the reader recognises the event.

decisions.choice: "아론의 얼굴 앞에서" at Literal; "살아 있는 동안" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom; the other levels give the sense the meaning decision states, during Aaron's lifetime.

decisions.choice: "lửa lạ" (L), "lửa không đúng phép" (B), "thứ lửa không đúng" (R)
decisions.reason: "lửa lạ" is the Literal wording of Leviticus 10:1 in Vietnamese; for most readers it says only "unfamiliar fire", so Balanced and Readable say what was wrong with it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: fogo estranho (L); um fogo não autorizado (B); um fogo que não era o certo (R)
decisions.reason: As Leviticus 10:1 sets it in Portuguese for this event (m1): Literal keeps "fogo estranho", the name readers know; Balanced says "não autorizado", fire God had not commanded; Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable says "the wrong kind of fire".

decisions.choice: "እንግዳ እሳት" (L), "ያልተፈቀደ እሳት" (B), "ትክክል ያልሆነ እሳት" (R), as Leviticus 10:1 has it.

decisions.choice: bring near: bring forward for service
decisions.reason: The verb is used for presenting someone or something before God or a priest (8:9-10; Exodus 29:4). Here it marks the Levites out for a new task.

decisions.choice: serve him: assist Aaron as his helpers
decisions.reason: The verb means to minister or to wait on someone, as Joshua served Moses (Exodus 24:13; 33:11). The Levites are not priests; they help the priests (18:2-7).

decisions.choice: the tribe of Levi: the tribe Aaron and Moses came from
decisions.reason: Levi is the tribe left out of the military census of chapter 1 (1:47-53). It is now given its own work and its own count.

decisions.choice: "người" for Aaron when God speaks of him; "ông" in the narrative
decisions.reason: In God's speech the third person is "người", as in the Vietnamese of Exodus and Leviticus; the narrator speaks of Aaron and Moses as "ông". Book-wide for these chapters.

decisions.choice: tu (Faz, apresenta, Leva)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks to Moses alone, so the commands of verses 6-10 and 40-48 use "tu", as in 1:49. The Levites are "eles", as the Hebrew turns from "the tribe" to "they".

vi.B: Họ phải thi hành phận sự cho người và cho cả hội chúng trước Lều Hội Kiến, khi làm công việc của Đền Tạm.
vi.R: Họ sẽ làm việc cho A-rôn và cho cả cộng đồng tại Lều Hội Kiến. Họ sẽ chăm lo Đền Tạm.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 회막 앞에서 그의 직무와 온 회중의 직무를 지켜, 성막의 일을 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 회막 앞에서 아론과 온 회중을 위하여 맡은 일을 하며 성막의 일을 해야 한다.
ko.R: 그들은 회막에서 아론과 온 회중을 위해 일할 것이다. 그들은 성막을 돌볼 것이다.

pt.L: E guardarão o encargo dele e o encargo de toda a comunidade diante da tenda do encontro, para fazer o serviço do tabernáculo.
pt.B: Eles cumprirão tarefas por ele e por toda a comunidade diante da tenda do encontro, fazendo o trabalho do tabernáculo.
pt.R: Eles vão trabalhar para Arão e para toda a comunidade na tenda do encontro. Vão cuidar do tabernáculo.

am.L: በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ፊት የማደሪያውን አገልግሎት በማገልገል የእርሱን ጥበቃና የማኅበሩን ሁሉ ጥበቃ ይጠብቃሉ።
am.B: የማደሪያውን ሥራ በሚሠሩበት ጊዜ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት ለእርሱና ለማኅበሩ ሁሉ ተግባራቸውን ይፈጽሙ።
am.R: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ለእርሱና ለማኅበሩ ሁሉ ይሠራሉ። ማደሪያውንም ይንከባከባሉ።

decisions.choice: keep his charge: carry out the duties given to them, on his behalf
decisions.reason: The noun means a watch, a duty, something entrusted to someone's care. The Levites guard and serve for Aaron, and for the whole people, who could not themselves come near the holy things (1:53; 18:3-4).

decisions.choice: the service of the tabernacle: its work, especially carrying and caring for it
decisions.reason: "Service" here is labor: taking the tabernacle down, carrying it and setting it up (1:50-51; 4:1-33), not the offerings, which belong to the priests.

decisions.choice: carry out duties / do work
decisions.reason: "Keep the charge" is a set phrase in these chapters. Balanced and Readable say what it means; Literal keeps "charge" each time.

decisions.choice: "guardar el encargo" (L); "cumplir funciones" (B); "trabajar para" (R)
decisions.reason: The noun is a watch or a duty entrusted to someone (m1). "Encargo" is a charge given into someone's care, which keeps the set phrase recognisable at Literal from 1:53 through chapters 3-4, 8 and 18; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "garder la charge" (L); "s'acquitter de fonctions" (B); "travailler pour" (R)
decisions.reason: The noun is a watch or a duty entrusted to someone (m1). Literal keeps "garder la charge", as at 1:53, so that the set phrase can be followed through chapters 3-4; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "kushika ulinzi" (L); "kutimiza majukumu" (B); "kufanya kazi" (R)
decisions.reason: The noun is a watch or a duty entrusted to someone (m1). Literal keeps "kushika ulinzi", as at 1:53, so that the set phrase can be followed through chapters 3-4; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "직무를 지키다" (Literal), "맡은 일을 하다" (Balanced), "일하다 / 돌보다" (Readable) for "keep the charge"
decisions.reason: "직무를 지키다" is the phrase Korean Leviticus 8:35 uses for the same Hebrew; the other levels say what the duties were. The pattern holds through Numbers 3-4.

decisions.choice: guardar o encargo (L); cumprir tarefas (B); trabalhar, cuidar (R); o serviço do tabernáculo (L)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the noun is a duty entrusted to someone's care (m1). Literal keeps one word for it each time, "encargo", with "guardar" for its verb, as at 1:53; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does. "Serviço" (L) is labour for the tent, not worship (m2); Balanced and Readable say "trabalho". Readable names Aaron where the Hebrew says "him".

decisions.choice: "ጥበቃ ይጠብቃሉ" (L), "ተግባራቸውን ይፈጽሙ" (B), "ይሠራሉ", "ይንከባከባሉ" (R) for "keep the charge" (mishmeret), through chapters 1-4.
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pairs a verb and noun from one root, "keep the keeping"; Literal keeps the pair, the other levels say what the duty was.

source.text: וְשָׁמְר֗וּ אֶֽת־כָּל־כְּלֵי֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will keep all [the] articles of [the] tent of meeting, and [the] charge of [the] sons of Israel, to serve [the] service of the tabernacle.

en.L: And they shall keep all the articles of the tent of meeting and the charge of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
en.B: They are to take care of all the furnishings of the tent of meeting and carry out the duties of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} as they do the work of the tabernacle.
en.R: They will take care of everything used in the meeting tent. They will do the work at the tabernacle for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: Y guardarán todos los utensilios de la Tienda del Encuentro, y el encargo de los hijos de Israel, para hacer el servicio del tabernáculo.
es.B: Cuidarán de todo el mobiliario de la Tienda del Encuentro y cumplirán las funciones de los israelitas, haciendo el trabajo del tabernáculo.
es.R: Cuidarán todo lo que se usa en la Tienda del Encuentro. Harán el trabajo del tabernáculo en favor de los israelitas.

fr.L: Et ils garderont tous les objets de la tente de la Rencontre, et la charge des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, pour faire le service de la Demeure.
fr.B: Ils prendront soin de tout le mobilier de la tente de la Rencontre et s’acquitteront des fonctions des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, en faisant le travail de la Demeure.
fr.R: Ils s’occuperont de tout ce qui sert dans la tente de la Rencontre. Ils feront le travail de la Demeure pour les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Nao watavilinda vyombo vyote vya Hema la Kukutania, na ulinzi wa wana wa Israeli, kwa kufanya huduma ya maskani.
sw.B: Watavitunza vyombo vyote vya Hema la Kukutania na kutimiza majukumu ya Waisraeli, wakifanya kazi ya maskani.
sw.R: Watatunza vifaa vyote vinavyotumika katika Hema la Kukutania. Watafanya kazi ya maskani kwa ajili ya Waisraeli.

vi.L: Và họ sẽ giữ mọi vật dụng của Lều Hội Kiến, và phận sự của con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, để làm công việc của Đền Tạm.
vi.B: Họ phải coi sóc mọi vật dụng của Lều Hội Kiến và thi hành phận sự thay cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên khi làm công việc của Đền Tạm.
vi.R: Họ sẽ trông coi mọi đồ dùng trong Lều Hội Kiến. Họ sẽ làm công việc tại Đền Tạm thay cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 회막의 모든 기구를 지키고, 이스라엘 자손의 직무를 지켜, 성막의 일을 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 회막의 모든 기구를 돌보고, 이스라엘 백성이 해야 할 일을 맡아 성막의 일을 해야 한다.
ko.R: 그들은 회막에서 쓰는 모든 것을 돌볼 것이다. 그들은 이스라엘 사람들을 대신하여 성막에서 일할 것이다.

pt.L: E guardarão todos os utensílios da tenda do encontro e o encargo dos filhos de Israel, para fazer o serviço do tabernáculo.
pt.B: Eles cuidarão de todos os utensílios da tenda do encontro e cumprirão as tarefas dos israelitas, fazendo o trabalho do tabernáculo.
pt.R: Eles vão cuidar de todas as coisas usadas na tenda do encontro. Vão fazer o trabalho do tabernáculo pelos israelitas.

am.L: የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ፣ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ጥበቃ ይጠብቃሉ፤ የማደሪያውንም አገልግሎት ያገለግላሉ።
am.B: የማደሪያውን ሥራ በሚሠሩበት ጊዜ የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ይንከባከቡ፤ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ተግባር ይፈጽሙ።
am.R: በመገናኛው ድንኳን የሚገለገሉባቸውን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ይንከባከባሉ። ለእስራኤላውያንም በማደሪያው ሥራውን ይሠራሉ።

decisions.choice: articles: the furnishings and equipment of the tent
decisions.reason: The word covers any object made for a purpose: vessels, tools and furniture. The items given to each clan are listed in verses 25-26, 31 and 36-37.

decisions.choice: the charge of the sons of Israel: the duty owed by all Israel, done in their place
decisions.reason: The Levites do for the whole people what the people themselves owe to the sanctuary, as in verse 7.

source.text: וְנָתַתָּה֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו נְתוּנִ֨ם נְתוּנִ֥ם הֵ֨מָּה֙ ל֔וֹ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons; given, given [are] they to him from [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons; they [are] given, given to him from the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons. From among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} they are given entirely to him.
en.R: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons. They are given to him from among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} to belong to him completely.

es.L: Y darás los levitas a Aarón y a sus hijos; ellos [son] dados, dados a él de entre los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Da los levitas a Aarón y a sus hijos. De entre los israelitas, le son entregados por completo.
es.R: Dale los levitas a Aarón y a sus hijos. Son elegidos de entre los israelitas y se le entregan para que sean completamente suyos.

fr.L: Et tu donneras les Lévites à Aaron et à ses fils ; ils [sont] donnés, donnés à lui d’entre les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Donne les Lévites à Aaron et à ses fils. Parmi les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, ils lui sont entièrement donnés.
fr.R: Donne les Lévites à Aaron et à ses fils. Ils sont pris parmi les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} et lui sont donnés pour lui appartenir complètement.

sw.L: Nawe utawapa Haruni na wanawe Walawi; wao [ni] waliotolewa, waliotolewa kwake kutoka kwa wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Uwape Haruni na wanawe Walawi. Kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli, wametolewa kwake kabisa.
sw.R: Uwape Haruni na wanawe Walawi. Wametolewa kwake kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli ili wawe wake kabisa.

vi.L: Và ngươi sẽ giao người Lê-vi cho A-rôn và cho các con trai người; họ [là] những người được giao, được giao cho người từ con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Con hãy giao người Lê-vi cho A-rôn và các con trai người. Trong vòng dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, họ được giao trọn cho người.
vi.R: Hãy giao người Lê-vi cho A-rôn và các con trai người. Họ được lấy ra từ dân Y-sơ-ra-ên để hoàn toàn thuộc về A-rôn.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 레위인을 아론과 그의 아들들에게 주어라. 그들은 이스라엘 자손 가운데서 그에게 주어지고 주어진 자들이다.
ko.B: 레위인을 아론과 그의 아들들에게 맡겨라. 그들은 이스라엘 백성 가운데서 아론에게 온전히 주어진 사람들이다.
ko.R: 레위인을 아론과 그의 아들들에게 주어라. 그들은 이스라엘 사람들 가운데서 아론에게 주어져 온전히 그의 사람이 된다.

pt.L: E darás os levitas a Arão e aos seus filhos; eles [são] dados, dados a ele dentre os filhos de Israel.
pt.B: Dá os levitas a Arão e aos seus filhos. Dentre os israelitas, eles são dados inteiramente a ele.
pt.R: Dá os levitas a Arão e aos seus filhos. Eles são dados a ele dentre os israelitas, para pertencer a ele completamente.

am.L: ሌዋውያንንም ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ትሰጣለህ፤ እነርሱ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ለእርሱ የተሰጡ፣ የተሰጡ ናቸው።
am.B: ሌዋውያንን ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ስጣቸው። ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ፈጽመው ለእርሱ የተሰጡ ናቸው።
am.R: ሌዋውያንን ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ስጣቸው። ሙሉ በሙሉ የእርሱ እንዲሆኑ ከእስራኤላውያን መካከል ለእርሱ ተሰጥተዋል።

decisions.choice: given, given: wholly given
decisions.reason: Hebrew repeats a word to make it stronger. The Levites are handed over completely to Aaron, as a gift from the people (8:16, 19; 18:6).

decisions.choice: to him: to Aaron
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "to him", that is, to Aaron. The Samaritan Pentateuch and the Greek translation read "to me", as in 8:16, where the LORD says the Levites are given to him. Both are true in the book: the Levites belong to the LORD (verse 12) and are given to Aaron for service. Reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: given entirely / to belong to him completely
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable express the force of the repeated word (m1) with "entirely" and "completely". Literal keeps the repetition.

decisions.choice: "주어지고 주어진" for the doubled "given, given"
decisions.reason: The Literal keeps the Hebrew repetition, which the meaning decision reads as "wholly given"; Balanced and Readable say "온전히".

source.text: וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת־בָּנָיו֙ תִּפְקֹ֔ד וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־כְּהֻנָּתָ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And Aaron and his sons you will appoint, and they will keep their priesthood; and the stranger who comes near will be put to death.

en.L: And you shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood; and the outsider who comes near shall be put to death."
en.B: Appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out their duties as priests. Any outsider who comes near is to be put to death."
en.R: Put Aaron and his sons in charge, to do the work of priests. Anyone else who comes near the holy things must be put to death."

es.L: Y a Aarón y a sus hijos designarás, y guardarán su sacerdocio; y el extraño que se acerque será muerto».
es.B: Designa a Aarón y a sus hijos para que cumplan sus funciones de sacerdotes. Cualquier extraño que se acerque será condenado a muerte».
es.R: Pon a Aarón y a sus hijos a cargo, para que hagan el trabajo de los sacerdotes. Cualquier otra persona que se acerque a las cosas santas debe ser ejecutada».

fr.L: Et tu établiras Aaron et ses fils, et ils garderont leur sacerdoce ; et le profane qui s’approchera sera mis à mort. »
fr.B: Établis Aaron et ses fils pour qu’ils s’acquittent de leurs fonctions de prêtres. Tout profane qui s’approchera sera mis à mort. »
fr.R: Charge Aaron et ses fils de faire le travail des prêtres. Toute autre personne qui s’approche des choses saintes doit être mise à mort. »

sw.L: Nawe utawaweka Haruni na wanawe, nao watashika ukuhani wao; na mtu wa nje atakayekaribia atauawa."
sw.B: Uwaweke Haruni na wanawe ili watimize kazi yao ya ukuhani. Mtu yeyote wa nje atakayekaribia atauawa."
sw.R: Uwape Haruni na wanawe jukumu la kufanya kazi ya makuhani. Mtu mwingine yeyote atakayekaribia vitu vitakatifu lazima auawe."

vi.L: Và ngươi sẽ lập A-rôn và các con trai người, và họ sẽ giữ chức tế lễ của họ; và người ngoài nào đến gần sẽ bị xử tử."
vi.B: Hãy lập A-rôn và các con trai người để thi hành chức vụ thầy tế lễ. Người ngoài nào đến gần sẽ bị xử tử."
vi.R: Hãy giao cho A-rôn và các con trai người làm công việc của thầy tế lễ. Bất cứ ai khác đến gần các vật thánh đều phải bị xử tử."

ko.L: 그리고 너는 아론과 그의 아들들을 세워라. 그들이 자기들의 제사장 직분을 지킬 것이다. 그리고 가까이 오는 외부인은 죽임을 당할 것이다."
ko.B: 아론과 그의 아들들을 세워 제사장의 직무를 맡게 하여라. 외부인이 가까이 오면 죽임을 당해야 한다."
ko.R: 아론과 그의 아들들에게 제사장의 일을 맡겨라. 다른 사람이 거룩한 것에 가까이 오면 죽여야 한다."

pt.L: E designarás Arão e os seus filhos, e eles guardarão o seu sacerdócio; e o estranho que se aproximar será morto."
pt.B: Designa Arão e os seus filhos para exercerem as suas funções de sacerdotes. Qualquer estranho que se aproximar será morto."
pt.R: Põe Arão e os seus filhos como responsáveis, para fazerem o trabalho de sacerdotes. Qualquer outra pessoa que chegar perto das coisas sagradas deve ser morta."

am.L: አሮንንና ልጆቹንም ትሾማለህ፤ ክህነታቸውንም ይጠብቃሉ፤ የሚቀርበውም እንግዳ ይገደላል።»
am.B: አሮንንና ልጆቹን የክህነት ተግባራቸውን እንዲፈጽሙ ሹማቸው። ካህን ያልሆነ ማንም ሰው ቢቀርብ ይገደል።»

decisions.choice: appoint: put in charge of an office
decisions.reason: The verb used for counting the people in this chapter (verse 15) also means to put someone in charge (1:50; Genesis 39:4-5). Here it means to appoint.

decisions.choice: the outsider: anyone who is not a priest
decisions.reason: The word means a stranger or someone not belonging. In matters of the sanctuary it means anyone outside the priestly family, even a Levite or another Israelite (17:5; 18:7). It does not mean a foreigner here.

decisions.choice: who comes near: who approaches to do the priests' work
decisions.reason: "Come near" is used for drawing close to the altar and the holy things to serve (18:3, 7). The danger is in taking the priests' place, not in coming to the sanctuary to worship.

decisions.choice: comes near the holy things
decisions.reason: Readable says what is approached, following m3, so the reader does not think every visitor to the tent was killed.

records.literal_gloss: And I, look, I have taken the Levites from among [the] sons of Israel instead of every firstborn, [the] opening of [the] womb from [the] sons of Israel; and will be to me the Levites.

en.L: "And I, look, I have taken the Levites from among the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel in place of every firstborn that opens the womb among the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, and the Levites shall be {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}.
en.B: "Look, I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} have taken the Levites from among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} in place of every firstborn, the first child born to each mother in Israel. The Levites belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: "I have chosen the Levites from among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. They will take the place of every oldest son in Israel, the first baby each mother has. The Levites belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: «Y yo, he aquí, he tomado a los levitas de en medio de los hijos de Israel en lugar de todo primogénito que abre la matriz entre los hijos de Israel, y los levitas serán {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}.
es.B: «Mira, yo mismo he tomado a los levitas de entre los israelitas en lugar de todo primogénito, el primer hijo que da a luz cada madre en Israel. Los levitas {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen.
es.R: «He escogido a los levitas de entre los israelitas. Ellos ocuparán el lugar de cada hijo mayor en Israel, el primer bebé que tiene cada madre. Los levitas {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen.

fr.L: « Et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, voici, j’ai pris les Lévites du milieu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël à la place de tout premier-né qui ouvre le sein parmi les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, et les Lévites seront à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: « Voici, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui ai pris les Lévites parmi les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} à la place de tout premier-né, le premier enfant de chaque mère en Israël. Les Lévites {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiennent.
fr.R: « J’ai choisi les Lévites parmi les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Ils prendront la place de chaque fils aîné en Israël, le premier bébé de chaque mère. Les Lévites {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiennent.

decisions.choice: opening of the womb: the first child a mother bears
decisions.reason: The phrase defines "firstborn" by the mother: her first child (Exodus 13:2, 12). The firstborn sons of Israel were claimed by God (verse 13).

decisions.choice: in place of: the Levites stand in for Israel's firstborn
decisions.reason: Instead of each family giving its firstborn son to serve the LORD, the tribe of Levi is given to him in their place (verses 40-51; 8:16-18).

decisions.choice: And I, look: an emphatic opening
decisions.reason: The pronoun "I" stands first, before the word that calls for attention. It stresses that this is God's own act.

decisions.choice: every oldest son
decisions.reason: Readable says "oldest son" because verses 40-43 show that the firstborn males are meant, and "firstborn" is a hard word for young readers.

decisions.choice: "[con] mở lòng mẹ" for "the opening of the womb" at Literal
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "lòng mẹ" is the ordinary word for the womb in this sense; "tử cung" would be clinical. Balanced and Readable say "the first child each mother bears".

decisions.choice: "그리고 나, 보라, 내가" keeps the emphatic opening at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts "I" first and then "look"; the Literal keeps both. The English "Myself" span has no Korean counterpart, since Korean has no capitals (see 1:53).

decisions.choice: Eu mesmo (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the emphasis of "And I, look" (m3) with "Eu mesmo"; Literal keeps "eis que". "Eu" for God takes no setting span in Portuguese, so the English span on "myself" has none here.

decisions.choice: cada filho mais velho; o primeiro menino que cada mãe tem (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "oldest son" (r-en-1), Readable says "filho mais velho" here and in verses 40-50, and "o primeiro menino que cada mãe tem", the wording of Exodus 13:2 in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "የመጀመሪያ ወንድ ልጅ" (R) for the firstborn in 3:12-50; "በኩር" at Literal and Balanced.
decisions.reason: As the terms list has it ("በኩር" L, B; "የመጀመሪያ ልጅ" R). Only sons are counted here, so Readable says "son", as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: For to me [is] every firstborn; on [the] day I struck every firstborn in [the] land of Egypt I set apart for myself every firstborn in Israel, from man to beast. To me they will be. I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: For every firstborn [is] {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I set apart for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} every firstborn in Israel, from {{gender:human|man}} to beast. They shall be {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}. I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: For every firstborn is {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}. When I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I made holy to {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} every firstborn in Israel, both human and animal. They are to be {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: Every firstborn belongs to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. When I killed all the firstborn in Egypt, I set apart for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} every firstborn in Israel, both people and animals. They belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

es.L: Porque todo primogénito [es] {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}. El día en que herí a todo primogénito en la tierra de Egipto, aparté para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a todo primogénito en Israel, desde {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}} hasta el animal. Serán {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}. Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: Porque todo primogénito es {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}. Cuando herí de muerte a todos los primogénitos en la tierra de Egipto, consagré para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a todo primogénito en Israel, tanto de personas como de animales. Han de ser {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.R: Todo primogénito {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenece. Cuando maté a todos los primogénitos en Egipto, aparté para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a todo primogénito en Israel, tanto personas como animales. Ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Car tout premier-né [est] à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Le jour où j’ai frappé tout premier-né dans le pays d’Égypte, j’ai mis à part pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} tout premier-né en Israël, depuis {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} jusqu’à la bête. Ils seront à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Car tout premier-né est à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Quand j’ai frappé tous les premiers-nés du pays d’Égypte, je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suis consacré tout premier-né en Israël, les humains comme les animaux. Ils doivent être à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Tout premier-né {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartient. Quand j’ai fait mourir tous les premiers-nés en Égypte, j’ai mis à part pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} tous les premiers-nés en Israël, les gens comme les animaux. Ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiennent. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: Kwa maana kila mzaliwa wa kwanza [ni] {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Siku ile nilipompiga kila mzaliwa wa kwanza katika nchi ya Misri, nilijitengea kila mzaliwa wa kwanza katika Israeli, tangu mwanadamu hata mnyama. Watakuwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Mimi [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Kwa maana kila mzaliwa wa kwanza ni {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Nilipowapiga wazaliwa wote wa kwanza katika nchi ya Misri, nilijitakasia kila mzaliwa wa kwanza katika Israeli, wanadamu na wanyama pia. Watakuwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Kila mzaliwa wa kwanza ni {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Nilipowaua wazaliwa wote wa kwanza katika Misri, nilijitengea kila mzaliwa wa kwanza katika Israeli, watu na wanyama. Wao ni {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.L: Vì mọi con đầu lòng [đều] thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Vào ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đánh hạ mọi con đầu lòng trong xứ Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã biệt riêng cho mình mọi con đầu lòng trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ người đến thú vật. Chúng sẽ thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Vì mọi con đầu lòng đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đánh hạ mọi con đầu lòng trong xứ Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã biệt riêng ra thánh cho mình mọi con đầu lòng trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, cả người lẫn thú vật. Chúng phải thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.R: Mọi con đầu lòng đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. decisions.choice: the day I struck every firstborn in Egypt: the last plague
decisions.reason: God struck the firstborn of Egypt and passed over Israel's houses (Exodus 12:12, 29). From then on Israel's firstborn, of people and of animals, belonged to him (Exodus 13:2, 11-15).

decisions.choice: I set apart: made holy, claimed as belonging to God
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something holy, set apart for God's own use. The firstborn were his; that is why they had to be given to him or bought back (Exodus 13:13; 34:20).

decisions.choice: from man to beast: people and animals alike
decisions.reason: A way of saying "all", from one end of the range to the other. The Levites replace the firstborn sons; firstborn animals of the Levites replace those of Israel's livestock (verses 41, 45).

decisions.choice: I am Yahweh: the seal on the command
decisions.reason: The closing words give God's own name as the authority for what he has said, as often in Leviticus (Leviticus 18:5; 19:12).

decisions.choice: made holy to myself
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "made holy" to keep the link with "holy" (m2); Literal and Readable use "set apart".

decisions.choice: "người" for "man" in "from man to beast", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "người" means a human being of either sex, so Vietnamese has one wording for both of the English setting's choices.

decisions.choice: "처음 난 것" where the firstborn of people and animals are meant together; "맏아들" for the firstborn sons of Israel (3:12, 40-50)
decisions.reason: The term sheet sets "맏아들" for a firstborn son and "처음 난 것" for the firstborn of animals; a verse that joins people and beasts needs the wider word. "사람" covers the English "human / man" setting, so Korean needs no gender span.

decisions.choice: consagrei (B); separei (L, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "consagrei", which keeps the link with holiness (m2) as the English "made holy" does, and reads more naturally than "santifiquei"; Literal and Readable say "separei", as the English "set apart".

decisions.choice: "ከሰው እስከ እንስሳ" with no gender span.
decisions.reason: "ሰው" already means a human being of either sex, so the English span ("human" or "man") has nothing to switch in Amharic.

decisions.choice: enroll: count and record by name
decisions.reason: The verb means to visit, inspect or muster, and in the census lists to count and register people (1:2-3, 19). The same verb means "appoint" in verse 10.

decisions.choice: every male from one month old: a count for the sanctuary, not for war
decisions.reason: The other tribes were counted from twenty years old as men able to go to war (1:3). The Levites are counted from one month, the age at which a firstborn son was bought back (18:15-16), because they are to stand in place of Israel's firstborn (verses 40-43).

decisions.choice: house of their fathers, clans: the family groups within a tribe
decisions.reason: A tribe was made up of clans, and a clan of ancestral households, each named for a forefather (1:2).

decisions.choice: enroll / count
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced use "enroll", as in the census of chapter 1, and Readable "count", each time the verb is used for the census in this chapter.

decisions.choice: "tous les garçons et les hommes"
decisions.reason: Chapter 1 says "tout homme" at Balanced and Readable for men of twenty and over; here the count starts at one month (m2), so "homme" alone would leave out the baby boys. Literal keeps "tout mâle", as in chapter 1.

decisions.choice: "kila wa kiume" (L, B); "kila mvulana na mwanamume" (R)
decisions.reason: Chapter 1 says "kila mwanamume" for men of twenty and over; here the count starts at one month (m2), and "mwanamume" would suggest grown men only. "Wa kiume" covers every male, baby or man; Readable spells it out.

decisions.choice: "mọi bé trai và đàn ông" for "every male" at Readable
decisions.reason: The count starts at one month old; Readable names both babies and men so that the reader sees this is not the count of fighting men in chapter 1, as the English Readable does with "every boy and man".

decisions.choice: todos os do sexo masculino (L, B); todos os meninos e homens (R)
decisions.reason: For the Levite counts of chapters 3 and the firstborn: those counted include babies of one month (m2), so "todo homem", used in 1:2 for men of war, would be wrong here. "Do sexo masculino" is the plain Portuguese for "male" of people ("macho" is said of animals); Readable says "meninos e homens", as the English Readable says "boy and man". The verb is "recensear" (L, B) and "contar" (R), as set at 1:2.

decisions.choice: according to the mouth of Yahweh: at the LORD's command
decisions.reason: "Mouth" stands for what someone says. Moses acts on the LORD's spoken word (verses 39, 51; 9:18).

decisions.choice: just as the LORD had told him
decisions.reason: Readable names the one who commanded, whom the Hebrew passive leaves unnamed but plain from the context.

decisions.choice: "theo miệng" (L), "theo lệnh" (B) for "according to the mouth of"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, which a Vietnamese reader can follow; Balanced gives its sense, the LORD's command. Used again in 3:39, 51 and 4:37-49.

decisions.choice: pela boca do SENHOR (L); por ordem do SENHOR (B)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Literal keeps the idiom "mouth" for what the LORD says (m1), as Exodus 38:21 says "pela boca de Moisés"; Balanced says "por ordem". Readable names the one who commanded, as the English does, with "mandado" to avoid repeating "ordenado".

decisions.choice: "በ… ቃል" (L) and "በ… ትእዛዝ" (B) for "according to the mouth of" YHWH, through the book.
decisions.reason: Amharic does not say a command comes from someone's "mouth"; "ቃል" (word) is the nearest natural form and keeps Literal close to the Hebrew picture.

decisions.choice: Gershon, Kohath and Merari: the sons of Levi
decisions.reason: The same three are listed in Genesis 46:11 and Exodus 6:16. Each gives his name to one of the three Levite groups whose work and camp are set out in verses 21-37.

decisions.choice: "게르손", "그핫", "므라리", and in 3:18-35 "립니", "시므이", "아므람", "이스할", "헤브론", "웃시엘", "마흘리", "무시", "엘리사반", "라엘", "수리엘", "아비하일"
decisions.reason: The forms Korean Exodus 6:16-22 already uses for Levi's family; "그핫" rather than "고핫", which some Korean Chronicles passages have, so that the Pentateuch reads as one.

decisions.choice: Levi's sons and grandsons as in Exodus 6:16-22: ጌድሶን, ቀዓት, ሜራሪ; ሎቤኒ, ሰሜኢ; እንበረም, ይስዓር, ኬብሮን, ዑዝኤል; ሞሖሊ, ሙሲ. The clans are named with "-ውያን": ጌድሶናውያን, ቀዓታውያን, ሜራራውያን, ሎቤናውያን, ሰሜአውያን, እንበረማውያን, ይስዓራውያን, ኬብሮናውያን, ዑዝኤላውያን, ሞሖላውያን, ሙሳውያን.
alternatives: "የጌድሶን ልጆች" for "the Gershonites" at every level
decisions.reason: One spelling for the whole Pentateuch. The "-ውያን" forms answer the Hebrew clan names ("the Libnite", "the Gershonite"), as "ቆሬያውያን" does in Exodus 6:24.

fr.R: Le clan des Libnites et le clan des Shiméïtes venaient de Guershon. C’étaient les clans des Guershonites.

vi.R: Gia tộc Líp-ni và gia tộc Si-mê-i ra từ Ghẹt-sôn. Đó là các gia tộc Ghẹt-sôn.

pt.B: De Gérson vieram o clã dos libnitas e o clã dos simeítas. Esses eram os clãs gersonitas.
pt.R: O clã dos libnitas e o clã dos simeítas vieram de Gérson. Eles eram os clãs gersonitas.

am.L: ለጌድሶን የሎቤናውያን ጎሳና የሰሜአውያን ጎሳ [ነበሩ]፤ እነዚህ የጌድሶናውያን ጎሳዎች ናቸው።
am.B: ከጌድሶን የሎቤናውያን ጎሳና የሰሜአውያን ጎሳ ተገኙ። እነዚህ የጌድሶናውያን ጎሳዎች ነበሩ።
am.R: የሎቤናውያን ጎሳና የሰሜአውያን ጎሳ ከጌድሶን የተገኙ ናቸው። እነርሱ የጌድሶናውያን ጎሳዎች ነበሩ።

decisions.choice: to Gershon: the clans descended from Gershon
decisions.reason: "To Gershon" marks what belongs to him, here the clans that come from his two sons (verse 18). The same form opens the Kohathite and Merarite sections (verses 27, 33).

decisions.choice: clan names in "-itas", lowercase: "los libnitas", "los simeítas", "los gersonitas" (and coatitas, meraritas in verses 27-35)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew forms adjectives of belonging from the clan fathers' names; Spanish forms them with "-ita", written in lowercase like other names of peoples (los levitas, los israelitas), built on the names as written in verses 17-20 (Gersón, Coat, Simí).

decisions.choice: clan names in "-ites": "les Libnites", "les Shiméïtes", "les Guershonites" (and Kehathites, Merarites in verses 27-35)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew forms adjectives of belonging from the clan fathers' names (Libnite, Shimeite, Gershonite); French forms them the same way, built on the names as written in verses 17-20, as it does for the Hittites or the Amorites.

decisions.choice: clan names with the prefix "Wa-": "Walibni", "Washimei", "Wagershoni" (and Wakohathi, Wamerari in verses 27-35)
decisions.reason: Swahili names a people or clan with the prefix "Wa-" on the founder's name, as in Walawi and Waisraeli, so each clan name is the father's name as written in verses 17-20 with "Wa-".

decisions.choice: "gia tộc Líp-ni" for "the clan of the Libnites"; "các gia tộc Ghẹt-sôn", "người Ghẹt-sôn" for the Gershonites
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has no ending like "-ite"; a clan is named after its ancestor, and the people of the group are "người" plus the name. Used for all the Levite clans in chapters 3-4.

decisions.choice: "립니 사람들의 가문" (Literal) and "립니 가문" (Balanced, Readable) for "the clan of the Libnites"; "게르손 사람들" (Literal) / "게르손 자손" (Balanced, Readable) for "the Gershonites"
decisions.reason: Korean has no suffix like English "-ite"; Literal keeps the Hebrew's plural people-name with "사람들", and the other levels use the plain Korean way of naming a clan after its ancestor. The same pattern serves the Kohathite and Merarite clans.

decisions.choice: os gersonitas, os coatitas, os meraritas; libnitas, simeítas, anramitas, izaritas, hebronitas, uzielitas, malitas, musitas
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the clan names take the Portuguese ending "-ita", lowercase, as "os levitas" and "os israelitas", formed on the names set in Exodus 6 (Gérson, Coate, Merari, Libni, Simei, Anrão, Izar, Hebrom, Uziel, Mali, Musi). "Simeítas" takes an accent to keep the "i" stressed, and keeps it apart from "simeonitas", the tribe of Simeon.

records.literal_gloss: Their enrolled [men], by [the] number of every male from a son of a month and upward, their enrolled [men were] seven thousand and five hundred.

en.L: Their enrolled [men], by the number of every male from a son of a month and upward, their enrolled [men were] 7,500.
en.B: The number of those enrolled, counting every male one month old and up, was 7,500.
en.R: When they counted every boy and man at least one month old, there were 7,500.

es.L: Sus alistados, según el número de todo varón desde [la edad de] un mes en adelante, sus alistados [fueron] 7 500.
es.B: El número de alistados, contando a todo varón de un mes o más, fue de 7 500.
es.R: Al contar a todos los niños y hombres de por lo menos un mes, hubo 7 500.

fr.L: Leurs recensés, selon le nombre de tout mâle depuis [l’âge d’]un mois et au-dessus, leurs recensés [furent] 7 500.
fr.B: Le nombre des recensés, en comptant tous les garçons et les hommes d’un mois et plus, fut de 7 500.
fr.R: On a compté tous les garçons et les hommes d’au moins un mois : il y en avait 7 500.

sw.L: Walioandikishwa wao, kwa hesabu ya kila wa kiume kuanzia mwana wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, walioandikishwa wao [walikuwa] 7,500.
sw.B: Idadi ya walioandikishwa, wakihesabiwa wote wa kiume wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, ilikuwa 7,500.
sw.R: Walipohesabu wavulana na wanaume wote wa angalau mwezi mmoja, walikuwa 7,500.

vi.L: Những người được kiểm kê của họ, theo số mọi người nam từ một tháng tuổi trở lên, những người được kiểm kê của họ [là] 7.500.
vi.B: Số người được kiểm kê, tính mọi người nam từ một tháng tuổi trở lên, là 7.500.
vi.R: Khi đếm mọi bé trai và đàn ông từ một tháng tuổi trở lên, có 7.500 người.

ko.L: 그들의 계수된 자들은 한 달 된 아들부터 그 이상으로 모든 남자의 수대로 [세면], 그들의 계수된 자들이 7,500[명]이었다.
ko.B: 한 달 이상 된 남자를 모두 세어 보니, 계수된 사람은 7,500명이었다.
ko.R: 한 달 이상 된 남자아이와 남자를 모두 세어 보니 7,500명이었다.

pt.L: Os recenseados deles, segundo o número de todos os do sexo masculino de um mês para cima, os recenseados deles [foram] 7.500.
pt.B: O número dos recenseados, contando todos os do sexo masculino de um mês para cima, foi 7.500.
pt.R: Quando contaram todos os meninos e homens de pelo menos um mês de idade, eram 7.500.

am.L: ከእነርሱ የተቆጠሩት፣ ከአንድ ወር ልጅ ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ባለው ወንድ ሁሉ ቁጥር፣ የተቆጠሩት 7,500 [ነበሩ]።
am.B: ዕድሜው አንድ ወርና ከዚያ በላይ የሆነው ወንድ ሁሉ ሲቆጠር የተመዘገቡት 7,500 ነበሩ።
am.R: ዕድሜው ቢያንስ አንድ ወር የሆነው ወንድ ሁሉ፣ ሕፃንም ይሁን አዋቂ፣ ሲቆጠር 7,500 ሆኑ።

decisions.choice: their enrolled, their enrolled: the subject said twice
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the subject, adds how the count was made, and names it again before the total. It is the pattern of the census lists (1:20-21).

decisions.choice: thousand: a numeral, the same word as in the census of chapter 1
decisions.reason: On the size of the numbers and the other meaning the word can have, see the note at 1:21.

source.text: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אַחֲרֵ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ יָֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] clans of the Gershonite[s] behind the tabernacle will camp, westward.

en.L: The clans of the Gershonites shall camp behind the tabernacle, westward.
en.B: The Gershonite clans were to camp behind the tabernacle, on the west side.
en.R: The Gershonite clans were to set up their tents behind the tabernacle, on the west side.

es.L: Los clanes de los gersonitas acamparán detrás del tabernáculo, hacia el occidente.
es.B: Los clanes gersonitas debían acampar detrás del tabernáculo, al lado oeste.
es.R: Los clanes de los gersonitas debían poner sus tiendas detrás del tabernáculo, al lado oeste.

fr.L: Les clans des Guershonites camperont derrière la Demeure, à l’occident.
fr.B: Les clans guershonites devaient camper derrière la Demeure, du côté ouest.
fr.R: Les clans des Guershonites devaient installer leurs tentes derrière la Demeure, du côté ouest.

sw.L: Koo za Wagershoni zitapiga kambi nyuma ya maskani, upande wa magharibi.
sw.B: Koo za Wagershoni zilipaswa kupiga kambi nyuma ya maskani, upande wa magharibi.
sw.R: Koo za Wagershoni zilitakiwa kupiga hema zao nyuma ya maskani, upande wa magharibi.

ko.B: 게르손 자손의 가문들은 성막 뒤쪽, 곧 서쪽에 진을 쳐야 했다.
ko.R: 게르손 자손의 가문들은 성막 뒤쪽인 서쪽에 천막을 쳐야 했다.

pt.L: Os clãs dos gersonitas acamparão atrás do tabernáculo, para o oeste.
pt.B: Os clãs gersonitas deviam acampar atrás do tabernáculo, do lado oeste.
pt.R: Os clãs gersonitas deviam armar as suas tendas atrás do tabernáculo, do lado oeste.

am.L: የጌድሶናውያን ጎሳዎች ከማደሪያው በስተ ኋላ ወደ ምዕራብ ይሰፍራሉ።
am.B: የጌድሶናውያን ጎሳዎች ከማደሪያው በስተ ኋላ በምዕራብ በኩል መስፈር ነበረባቸው።
am.R: የጌድሶናውያን ጎሳዎች ከማደሪያው በስተ ኋላ በምዕራብ በኩል ድንኳኖቻቸውን መትከል ነበረባቸው።

decisions.choice: behind the tabernacle, westward: the back of the tent was its west side
decisions.reason: The tabernacle faced east, toward the sunrise (verse 38; Exodus 27:13), so "behind" is west. The word for west is literally "seaward", toward the Mediterranean Sea.

decisions.choice: camp: an inner ring of Levites round the tabernacle
decisions.reason: The three Levite groups camp on three sides of the tabernacle and the priests on the fourth, between the sanctuary and the other tribes (1:53; 2:17).

decisions.choice: were to camp
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is future in form, giving the arrangement as an order. Balanced and Readable use "were to", which fits the report of the census.

en.L: And the leader of the father's house of the Gershonites [was] Eliasaph son of Lael.
en.B: The leader of the ancestral family of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
en.R: The leader of the Gershonite families was Eliasaph son of Lael.

es.L: Y el jefe de la casa paterna de los gersonitas [era] Eliasaf hijo de Lael.
es.B: El jefe de la familia de los gersonitas era Eliasaf hijo de Lael.
es.R: El jefe de las familias gersonitas era Eliasaf, hijo de Lael.

fr.L: Et le chef de la maison du père des Guershonites [était] Éliasaph fils de Laël.
fr.B: Le chef de la famille des Guershonites était Éliasaph fils de Laël.
fr.R: Le chef des familles guershonites était Éliasaph, fils de Laël.

sw.B: Kiongozi wa jamaa ya Wagershoni alikuwa Eliasafu mwana wa Laeli.
sw.R: Kiongozi wa jamaa za Wagershoni alikuwa Eliasafu mwana wa Laeli.

vi.L: Và thủ lĩnh nhà cha của người Ghẹt-sôn [là] Ê-li-a-sáp con trai La-ên.
vi.B: Thủ lĩnh dòng họ Ghẹt-sôn là Ê-li-a-sáp con trai La-ên.
vi.R: Người lãnh đạo các gia đình Ghẹt-sôn là Ê-li-a-sáp con trai La-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 게르손 사람들의 조상의 집의 지도자는 라엘의 아들 엘리아삽[이었다].
ko.B: 게르손 자손 집안의 지도자는 라엘의 아들 엘리아삽이었다.
ko.R: 게르손 자손 집안들의 지도자는 라엘의 아들 엘리아삽이었다.

pt.L: E o líder da família dos gersonitas [era] Eliasafe, filho de Lael.
pt.B: O líder da família dos gersonitas era Eliasafe, filho de Lael.
pt.R: O líder das famílias gersonitas era Eliasafe, filho de Lael.

am.L: የጌድሶናውያንም የአባት ቤት አለቃ የላኤል ልጅ ኤሊያሳፍ [ነበረ]።
am.B: የጌድሶናውያን ቤተሰብ አለቃ የላኤል ልጅ ኤሊያሳፍ ነበረ።
am.R: የጌድሶናውያን ቤተሰቦች መሪ የላኤል ልጅ ኤሊያሳፍ ነበረ።

decisions.choice: leader of the father's house: the chief of the whole Gershonite group
decisions.reason: Here "father's house" is used of the whole group descended from Gershon, and its leader is over all its clans (compare verses 30, 35).

source.text: וּמִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת בְּנֵֽי־גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְהָאֹ֑הֶל מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמָסַ֕ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] charge of [the] sons of Gershon in [the] tent of meeting [was] the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, and [the] screen of [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting,

en.L: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting [was] the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, and the screen of the entrance of the tent of meeting,
en.B: In the tent of meeting, the Gershonites were in charge of the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting,
